description_en: Query the hotline number configuration list by instance ID. Fuzzy query by hotline number is supported
description_zh: 根据实例ID查询热线号码配置列表，支持通过热线号码模糊查询
name: QueryHotlineNumber

parameters.help_en:
The Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service (AICCS) instance ID.
You can obtain it from Instance Management in the left-side navigation pane of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The current page number. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页。取值大于0，默认值：1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页大小。取值大于0，默认值：20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The hotline number. Fuzzy query is supported
parameters.help_zh: 热线号码。支持模糊查询
parameters.name: hotline_number
